items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He was a new guy. He was the (Bunny) even then. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, that's right. Absolutely. Absolutely.

ctx.x: But all of our harmony was beautiful. This man was writing music like a champion then!
